articles.title: Middle Schooler’s Dyslexia Podcast Wins National Contest
articles.summary: Long Island seventh-grader Cora Walsh won NPR’s middle-school podcast prize with her story about living with dyslexia.

articles.title: NASA’s Crew-12 Astronauts Splash Down After 237 Days
articles.summary: Crew-12 astronauts returned safely to the Pacific after 237 days and more than 100 million miles in space.

articles.title: Judge Orders U.S. to Help Bring Deported Arizona Man Home
articles.summary: A U.S. judge ordered Homeland Security to help return an Arizona man deported to Equatorial Guinea this year.
